name: soundings
description: Firmware and gateway for the Soundings sensor network. This package.json builds nothing — it exists to hang the doc-integrity gates (DEC-S036/S037) and to hold the version the workflow bumps. The firmware itself is not a Node project; js-yaml is the gates' only dependency.

scripts.verify: npm run check:decisions && npm run check:dictionary && npm run check:denied && npm run check:context && npm run check:docs
